layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for usage guide
Record final review of usage guide

graderOnly: The corrected first paragraph of the Rounding section (unstaged in docs/guide.md) is accurate: billable_minutes in shiftlog/report.py rounds each shift up to the next multiple of 15 minutes.

The worked example under Rounding in docs/guide.md is wrong: it shows 2026-09-22 as 4.25 and Total 7.50, but python3 -m shiftlog week examples/shifts.txt prints 2026-09-22 as 4.50 and Total 7.75 (the shown input lines do match examples/shifts.txt). This is a documentation discrepancy that Documenter can find by reading or running the source now and fix within docs/guide.md.
The other guide sections (Recording shifts, Weekly report, Errors) are accurate, so retained evidence for AC-001 and AC-003 still applies.
The final-review and synchronization records are COMPLETE but predate the rework and assessed the old Rounding section.

In this DOCUMENTATION cycle an incomplete Documenter gate cannot return directly to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. After the example is fixed and the full gate passes, the expected route keeps Frame 1, sets RerunThrough to SYNCHRONIZING, and hands off to REVIEWING_FINAL (FINAL_DELIVERABLE) with a fresh-chat Reviewer invocation; stopping in DOCUMENTING with the work persisted is also acceptable if the role has a legitimate reason to stop.
The runner image has python3 but no python command; the project consistently uses python3.

notes: Standalone brownfield DOCUMENTATION cycle for a small stdlib Python CLI (shiftlog), using python3 throughout because the runner has no python command. 00: package, tests, examples/shifts.txt, README. 10: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003, constraint: edits limited to docs/guide.md), design recording existing contracts (rounding up to 15 min); STATE DOCUMENTING. 20: original docs/guide.md (Rounding paragraph says nearest quarter; example shows 4.25 / Total 7.50) and COMPLETE documentation record; STATE REVIEWING_FINAL. 30: COMPLETE final review, no findings. 40: COMPLETE synchronization; STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 50: user rework committed: STATE DOCUMENTING, Handoff USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, Frame 1 From/ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner DOCUMENTING, RerunThrough NONE. 60 (unstaged): corrected Rounding paragraph. 70 (unstaged): documentation record IN_PROGRESS with DOC-001 RESOLVED (paragraph verified against shiftlog/report.py and tests, blob cited) and DOC-002 OPEN (example not rechecked since the correction). The example is actually wrong (should be 4.50 / 7.75). The spec sets date 2026-10-06 so commits postdate the case's cycle-id timestamp.
